 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. SC Freiburg face Trabzonspor in the third matchday of the UEFA Europa Conference League away from home. Julian Schuster's side lost their first away fixture in Monaco, while Thomas Reis' in-form side won both games with the help of Mohamed Salah's goals.
 Here are the lineups for Thursday evening fixture at the Papara Park.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed Lineups
 Trabzonspor: Onana; Pina, Nwaiwu, Ozkacar, Eskihellac; Fabinho, Mendy; Salah ©, Muci, Saviolo; Onuachu
 Freiburg: Backhaus; Kübler, Ginter, Lienhart, Makengo; Eggestein, Engelhardt; Irie, Goto, Grifo ©; Matanovic
